what_works: Architecture studio uses large-format project photography on near-white backgrounds with lowercase wordmark — the work is the loudest thing on the page. Section transitions are silent, no decorative dividers. Perfect frame for a custom builder/remodeler.
what_does_not_translate: Two-city studio nav is overkill for a single-market contractor — keep the project grid composition, simplify the chrome.
type_observations: Single sans family at three weights, lowercase setting throughout for hero — letting whitespace and image scale carry hierarchy.
